static_traits.name: 明凯
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系：自事件后疏远；社交支持：有几位亲密朋友可倾诉，但尚not yet与他们讨论此次事件。
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet出现类似心理问题；not yet接受心理治疗或咨询；No major physical illness。
static_traits.language_features: 紧张但愿意求助与配合；表达清晰、逻辑较好；能够Reflection与自我检视；存在自我批评倾向；语速与语言风格Not mentioned。

basic_info.main_problem: 因为今天在工作中把一位顾客的订单弄错了，我觉得自己是个糟糕的员工，产生了without能感与自责，并持续反复回放该错误。
basic_info.core_demands: 此次工作事件trigger了强烈的负面情绪与自我批评，希望通过咨询来应对并缓解这些感受。

special_situations.event: At work, gets a customer's order wrong, is discovered by the manager and corrected on the spot
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在工作中犯错，就说明我not称职、not适合这份工作
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to be more careful, repeatedly checking orders to avoid making mistakes again

special_situations.event: 经理not yet多说话、表情严肃并迅速处理错误
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果上级have not正面反馈或显得not高兴，就代表他们对我失望并认定我without能
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping distance from colleagues to avoid being evaluated; avoiding communicating with the manager
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她一定觉得我not称职，我让她失望了

special_situations.event: 事后not停回想这次错误，忽略以往自己在工作中的Good表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次错误足以negate我过去的能力与表现
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continually focuses on mistake details to remind oneself to avoid repeating them

special_situations.event: 想到not yet来继续与顾客互动或再次上班
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 这次犯错意味着我以后会not断犯错并让所有人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly cautious, repeatedly double-checks to try to prevent all mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我以后会一直出错，会让大家失望

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized by superiors and colleagues, seen as competent, and accepted
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被批评、被视为without能、Being rejected或失去信任
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being judged by keeping distance from colleagues
Maintains control and a sense of safety through self-criticism and excessive caution

object_relations.object_representation: 沉默但可能失望与评判的管理者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到经理当场纠正订单且not yet明确表态，或面对他人沉默/严肃表情时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方的沉默解读为对自己失望，认为自己被视为without能（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和与尊重，先验证来访者的感受，再以开放式Questioning区分感受与证据，邀请其生成其他可能解释；避免评判与对抗。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当反复回想错误并体验强烈羞愧时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把本应指向情境的失望/怒气Turning against the self，认为“It is all my fault”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use支持性与Empathy的语气；帮助区分外部与内部责任边界；鼓励自我同情与可行的改进计划，降低自我惩罚。

manifestations: 自事件后与同事保持距离
尚not yet向亲密朋友倾诉此次事件
在工作场景中感到与他人隔离

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently blames oneself and labels oneself ('I am a bad employee')
Overly cautious at work, checks repeatedly to avoid making mistakes again
担心被评价而Repression真实感受

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动，或放弃向外寻求do not人为其做某事，转而对自己做，即The individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 与同事保持距离、not主动沟通求助
将对经理的担心和not满转为自我批评与羞愧
not与朋友讨论事件而独自承受压力

positive_force: Usually works conscientiously and carefully, with few mistakes (has basic job competence and strategies)
愿意求助并参与咨询，能够Reflection自己的思维模式
Has a certain degree of social support (has several close friends)
Can consider multiple possible explanations, open to evidence and feedback
negative_force: Tendencies toward catastrophizing and all-or-nothing thinking
读心术与预测not yet来导致过度担忧
Distances himself from colleagues out of fear of being judged, reducing external support
Fear of being criticized affects work performance and emotions

target_behavior.behavior: 过度自责与negate自我（将一次错误等同于not称职）
antecedent: 看到经理当场纠正订单且not yet明确评价
与顾客互动或准备上班时
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, and mind reading; fear of criticism and shame drive self-punishing thinking
target_behavior.function: Avoids the risk of negative evaluation by others; gains a sense of control through self-punishment
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与Anxiety；Work performance affected；持续反刍错误、Self-efficacy下降

target_behavior.behavior: 与同事保持距离、回避沟通求助
antecedent: Shifts and rest time after a mistake occurs at work
担心被认为not称职或被经理失望
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and personalization tendency, interprets others' possible reactions as negative evaluations of oneself
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评价与被批评的潜在not适
target_behavior.consequence: 人际支持减少、Loneliness感增加；Anxiety与Self-doubt维持甚至加重
